title: analysis-manifest
description: Schema for specs/analysis-manifest.json — the canonical state record for a quantum-toolbox metarepo.

registryFiles.description: Paths to source-of-truth registry file(s) that /update reconciles against (e.g. sources/urls.md, repos.json). Optional — projects without a structured catalog only use the flat URL list.

toolboxVersion.description: Toolkit version (semver) at the time of the last /upgrade run. Updated by /upgrade only.

lastAnalysis.description: Metadata about the most recent analysis run across all skills.

date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last analysis run.

repositories.description: Map of repo-name → last-analyzed commit SHA.

commit.description: Short commit SHA at the time of analysis.

docs.description: Map of documentation source URL (e.g. a Confluence page) → last-fetched state. Enables /update to diff by source version and re-fetch only changed pages instead of re-crawling everything.

version.description: Source system's page version/revision number at last fetch.

localPath.description: Path to the mirrored markdown file for this page.

crawlMode.description: recursive = this URL's page + all descendant pages were mirrored; single-page = only this page.

artifacts.description: Per-skill artifact records. Keys are skill names (e.g. 'arch-analysis', 'code-graph').

history.description: Append-only log of analysis runs. Each entry records what was run and when.

artifactEntry.description: State record for a single skill's output.

lastAnalyzedDate.description: ISO date when this skill last completed successfully.

lastAnalyzedCommit.description: Short commit SHA of the primary source repo when skill last ran.

sourceRepos.description: Repo names this skill covered in its last run.

generatedWithSkillVersion.description: Version of the skill (from manifest.yaml) used to generate this artifact.

views.description: List of generated view file paths relative to the metarepo root.

reports.description: List of generated report file paths relative to the metarepo root.

codeGraphArtifact.description: Extended artifact entry for the code-graph skill.

generatedDate.description: ISO date when the SQLite/YAML extraction completed.

examples: ts-morph v21 static AST extraction + node:sqlite

regenerate.description: Shell command to reproduce this extraction.

code_graph_mode.description: Backend/mode used for the most recent arch-analysis run.

repoCoverage.description: Repos analyzed / repos tracked in specs/repos.json.

languageCoverage.description: Languages extracted with a real type-aware tool or tree-sitter grammar / languages present across cloned repos.

crossRepoMechanismCoverage.description: Cross-repo correlation mechanisms (imports, HTTP, gRPC, queues, GraphQL federation, shared DB, OpenAPI, config) resolved into edges / mechanisms detected as present in the codebase.

gaps.description: Named reasons behind any coverage metric below 100% — excluded repos, AI-fallback languages, unresolved cross-repo mechanisms. Never leave a sub-100% metric unexplained.
